about: Limits for orders approved in the studio's view Beställ (tools/order-routes.ts refuses an approval beyond them) and the price table the cost is computed from (src/order-model.ts priceOf). The worst case counts: the tool's listed price where it is higher than what the ledgers show. Set enabled to false to stop every approval. The balance is the last one known; a receipt's creditsRemainingAfter is newer when there is one.
